summary: Renewal check-in to discuss contract extension (3-year option), capacity upgrades (move from reserved small to medium Dedicated pool), additional region coverage (eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1), and benchmark plan. Customer expressed interest in dedicated capacity for lower p95 latency and data residency; also requested SOC2/ISO docs and a short benchmark window. Pricing sensitivity around committed spend; asked about burst capacity, autoscale policies, and KMS integrations.
topics: Dedicated capacity sizing and burst options
Benchmarks: p95 latency, throughput, KV cache behavior
transcript:
Header:
Date: 2026-08-21
Start time: 16:00 PT
Duration: ~45 minutes
Attendees: Alex Morgan (Redwood AE), Priya Patel (Redwood SE), Laura Chen (CrownTrust), Marcus Rivera (CrownTrust), Samir Gupta (CrownTrust)
Recording link: https://redwood.app/recordings/ff-20260821-ctf

Summary: quick renewal + expansion sync, talk through capacity numbers, regions, security docs, and next steps for benchmark.

---
00:00 Alex: hey everyone thanks for joining, uh this is Alex from Redwood, Priya's here as well, we'll run through the renewal and the expansions you were thinking about.
00:12 Laura: thanks Alex, yeah appreciate it. we got the renewal notice - team wants to know options for a longer term commit and adding eu-west for latency to europe users.
00:25 Alex: great, yeah so quick context - you're on our hosted tier with a small reserved commit today, right? and you're seeing peak qps around 120 rps with a p95 about 220 ms?
00:38 Marcus: yeah that's about right, but peak spikes have gone up since last quarter. other big ask is data residency for eu customers, plus we'd like to reduce token cost per million if we commit longer.
00:52 Priya: hi all - on the technical side we did a perf-pass earlier, moving to Dedicated medium usually brings p95 down by ~30-40% for your workload given continuous batching + prefix cache. also we can enable burst capacity for traffic spikes so you don't hit throttling.
01:10 Samir: curious on autoscale - we run in our k8s infra for other services, but we want Redwood Dedicated to be predictable. how does autoscaling and burst work? any cold start?
01:22 Priya: good q. Dedicated is backed by reserved GPU pools; autoscale is fast within the pool, burst will borrow from shared capacity if enabled but it's subject to availability. cold start penalties are minimal if you keep a small baseline node count - and KV cache warmup helps reduce token compute on repeated prefixes.
01:40 Marcus: and region setup - can we get eu-west-1 and ap-south-east? we have offices in london and singapore.
01:47 Alex: yes we can provision Dedicated in those regions - region add-ons are extra cost but we can include a discounted rate in a 3-year commit. for private deployments (VPC) we can also do cross-region replication of logs and audit trails.
02:02 Laura: security - we need SOC 2 and ISO 27001, SSO/SAML, RBAC, and KMS/HSM support for keys. also audit logs retention.
02:12 Alex: absolutely, we'll send SOC 2 report and the ISO certs; Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS and HSM integrations, RBAC and long-term audit log retention. I'll attach the security whitepaper.
02:25 Samir: how about egress costs and data residency? we need logs to stay in region and not be copied to other clouds for compliance.
02:34 Priya: we can region-lock logs and the private control plane - in Dedicated or Private deployments we can keep logs in the customer's region. we'll confirm how the backup/DR behaves for eu-region.
02:46 Marcus: pricing - if we move to a 3-year contract with medium Dedicated + eu region + burst, what's the delta vs renewing 1 year?
02:57 Alex: ballpark, a 3-year commit gets you 20-30% off list on committed GPUs, and we can do a blended discount for region add-ons. i'll draft a formal proposal with line items.
03:10 Laura: we also want to run a 2-week benchmark with our real traffic to validate p95 and cost. can Redwood spin up trial Dedicated?
03:20 Priya: yes, we can provision a trial Dedicated cluster in us-east-1 with burst enabled and run the harness. we'll need sample traces and some representative prompts.
03:31 Samir: i'll share traces and current QPS, plus peak window patterns. also want to test KV cache effectiveness cause we use a lot of prefix-heavy prompts.
03:43 Priya: nice - KV cache should show good savings on your traffic shape. we'll measure token cost and average latency, and capture p50/p95/p99.
03:55 Marcus: any migration work? right now integration is via API and webhook. we want zero downtime.
04:02 Alex: minimal - same API surface, you can pin model versions. if you opt for Private there's a bit more infra work but Redwood provides the deployment docs and we can help with SRE.
04:17 Laura: competitors - we've looked at Anthropic and OpenAI's enterprise offers, and a small SI offered on-prem. price is a factor but reliability and observability matter more for us.
04:28 Alex: understood. Redwood's differentiate is production tooling - token-level cost breakdowns, tracing and rollouts, and ability to do canary fallbacks.
04:36 Samir: question on KMS - do you support AWS KMS and external HSM connectors?
04:41 Priya: yes AWS KMS and a few HSM vendors; for Private we can integrate customer-managed keys and keep key material out of Redwood managed control plane.
04:53 Marcus: ok good. also want to confirm SLA for Dedicated - p95 latency SLO and uptime?
05:00 Alex: we'll include the Dedicated SLA in the proposal; for medium pools we target p95 within agreed thresholds, and we have multi-zone redundancy.
05:12 Laura: anything else we should test? maybe model quantization and accuracy regressions - we don't want quality drop if you change to quantized variants to save cost.
05:25 Priya: we'll include quality checks and eval prompts in the benchmark; Redwood Optimize can provide quantization recommendations and we can lock to model variants for canary testing.
05:36 Marcus: timeline - we'd like to close renewal by end of next month if numbers look good; pilot this week or next.
05:46 Alex: sounds doable. i'll send the proposal by Tuesday, Priya will set up the benchmark template, Samir shares traces.
05:55 Laura: thanks everyone, appreciate the fast turnaround.
06:00 Alex: thanks all, we'll follow up with docs + proposal. bye.
